This plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, and I use it for something other than my main cereal crop. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but DAP and urea are expensive this year, so I will only put a small amount on this plot and save the rest for my bigger fields. I keep a few cattle, so I can spread manure here from the kraal, which costs me nothing. I don't have irrigation here — we depend on the meher rains — and my wife and children will do most of the work, though I may call a neighbor for a few days at weeding time.
